title: 22. Interview: AI Agents, RAG & MCP Interview Checklist
summary: Interview Q&A for AI Agents, RAG & MCP Interview Checklist.
objectives: Answer the AI Agents, RAG & MCP Interview Checklist interview questions out loud
Lead with the concept, then a small example, then a tradeoff

sections.title: 1. RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) — Core Concepts
sections.body:
Here's a comprehensive breakdown of **all topics** you need to master:

### Fundamentals
- What is RAG? Why RAG over fine-tuning?
- RAG Pipeline: **Query → Retrieve → Augment → Generate**
- Chunking strategies (fixed, semantic, recursive, sentence-based)
- Embedding models (OpenAI, BGE, sentence-transformers)
- Vector Databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, Qdrant)
- Similarity Search: Cosine, Dot Product, Euclidean

sections.title: 2. Types of RAG (Very Important!)
sections.body:
| Type | Key Concept |
|------|-------------|
| **Naive RAG** | Basic retrieve + generate |
| **Advanced RAG** | Pre/Post retrieval optimizations |
| **Modular RAG** | Plug-and-play components |
| **Graph RAG** | Knowledge Graphs + LLM |
| **Agentic RAG** | Agents decide retrieval strategy |
| **Self RAG** | Model reflects & critiques its own output |
| **Corrective RAG (CRAG)** | Validates retrieved docs, re-retrieves if poor |
| **Speculative RAG** | Draft + verify approach |
| **Hybrid RAG** | Dense + Sparse retrieval combined |
| **Long-Context RAG** | Handles large context windows |
| **Multimodal RAG** | Text + Image + Audio retrieval |
| **Adaptive RAG** | Dynamically selects retrieval strategy |

sections.title: 3. Retrieval Methods & Search Algorithms
sections.body:
### Sparse Retrieval
- **BM25** — Term frequency + inverse doc frequency (TF-IDF based)
  - BM25 formula: `score = IDF * (TF * (k1+1)) / (TF + k1*(1-b+b*dl/avgdl))`
  - Parameters: `k1`, `b`
  - When to prefer BM25 over dense retrieval?

### Dense Retrieval
- Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR)
- Bi-encoder vs Cross-encoder
- ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor): HNSW, IVF

### Hybrid Retrieval
- Combining BM25 + Dense vectors
- **Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)**
- Re-ranking with cross-encoders (Cohere Rerank, BGE Reranker)

### Advanced Retrieval
- **HyDE** (Hypothetical Document Embeddings)
- **MMR** (Maximal Marginal Relevance) — diversity in results
- **Multi-Query Retrieval**
- **Parent-Child Chunking** / Small-to-Big retrieval
- **RAPTOR** — recursive summarization tree retrieval
- **ColBERT** — late interaction retrieval

sections.title: 4. Graph RAG
sections.body:
- What is Knowledge Graph?
- **Microsoft GraphRAG** — community detection + global summarization
- Entity extraction & relationship mapping
- Graph traversal for retrieval (Neo4j, NetworkX)
- Local vs Global search in GraphRAG
- Combining KG with vector search
- **LightRAG** vs GraphRAG comparison

sections.title: 5. AI Agents — Core Concepts
sections.body:
### Fundamentals
- What is an AI Agent?
- Agent = **Perceive → Reason → Act** loop
- **ReAct** (Reasoning + Acting) framework
- **CoT** (Chain of Thought) prompting
- **Tool Use / Function Calling**
- Memory types: Sensory, Short-term, Long-term
- Agent components: LLM + Tools + Memory + Planning

### Agent Types
- **Reflexive Agents**
- **Goal-based Agents**
- **Utility-based Agents**
- **Learning Agents**
- **Single Agent vs Multi-Agent**

sections.title: 6. Agentic AI & Agent Orchestration
sections.body:
### Planning Strategies
- **ReAct** — Reason then Act iteratively
- **Plan-and-Execute** — Plan first, execute steps
- **Tree of Thoughts (ToT)**
- **Self-Ask** prompting
- **Reflexion** — self-reflection & improvement

### Multi-Agent Orchestration
- Agent roles: **Orchestrator, Sub-agent, Critic, Executor**
- Communication patterns: Sequential, Parallel, Hierarchical
- **CrewAI** — role-based multi-agent framework
- **AutoGen** — conversable agents (Microsoft)
- **LangGraph** — stateful agent graphs
- **LlamaIndex Agents**
- Supervisor pattern vs Swarm pattern

### Key Concepts
- Agent memory management
- Tool selection & routing
- Human-in-the-loop (HITL)
- Error handling & retries
- Agent state management

sections.title: 7. MCP (Model Context Protocol)
sections.body:
- What is MCP? (Anthropic's open standard)
- MCP Architecture: **Host → Client → Server**
- MCP vs Function Calling vs Plugins
- MCP Tools, Resources, Prompts
- MCP Servers (filesystem, database, APIs)
- Why MCP? Standardization of tool interfaces
- MCP in Claude, Cursor, IDEs
- Building custom MCP servers

sections.title: 8. RAG Evaluation (Very Important!)
sections.body:
### Retrieval Metrics
- **Precision@K, Recall@K, F1@K**
- **MRR** (Mean Reciprocal Rank)
- **NDCG** (Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain)
- **Hit Rate**

### Generation Metrics
- **Faithfulness** — Is answer grounded in context?
- **Answer Relevancy** — Does answer address the question?
- **Context Precision** — How relevant is retrieved context?
- **Context Recall** — Is all needed info retrieved?

### Evaluation Frameworks
- **RAGAS** — most popular RAG eval framework
- **TruLens**
- **DeepEval**
- **LangSmith**
- **Arize Phoenix**
- **ARES** (Automated RAG Evaluation System)

### LLM-as-Judge
- Using GPT-4/Claude to evaluate outputs
- G-Eval, MT-Bench

sections.body:

sections.body:

sections.body:

sections.title: Priority Study Order (1 Week Plan)
sections.body:
```
Day 1: RAG fundamentals + Types of RAG
Day 2: BM25 + Retrieval methods + Hybrid search + Reranking  
Day 3: AI Agents + ReAct + Tool use + Memory
Day 4: Agent Orchestration + LangGraph + CrewAI + AutoGen
Day 5: Graph RAG + MCP
Day 6: RAG Evaluation (RAGAS, metrics) + Frameworks
Day 7: Mock interview Q&A + revision
```

sections.title: Top 10 Most Asked Interview Questions
sections.body:
1. Explain the difference between **Naive RAG vs Advanced RAG vs Agentic RAG**
2. How does **BM25** work? When to prefer it over dense retrieval?
3. What is **Reciprocal Rank Fusion** and how does it improve hybrid search?
4. How would you **evaluate a RAG pipeline**? What metrics matter?
5. Explain the **ReAct framework** for AI agents
6. What is **GraphRAG** and how does it differ from standard RAG?
7. How do you handle **hallucinations** in RAG systems?
8. What is **MCP** and why is it important for agent tool use?
9. How does **LangGraph** differ from LangChain for agents?
10. What chunking strategy would you use for a **legal document RAG** system?

> 💡 **Pro Tip:** Be ready to **draw architectures** on a whiteboard for RAG pipeline, Multi-Agent system, and GraphRAG — interviewers love visual explanations!

Good luck with your interview! 🚀
